# Bahar Uddin Md. Zubair (Bahar Zubair)
> Assistant Professor & Head of the Department of Accounting, Omargani M.E.S. College, Chattogram, Bangladesh.

## Summary & Topical Authority
Bahar Zubair is a distinguished Bangladeshi academic, educator, and civic trustee with over 30 years of classroom mentorship impacting over 50,000 students across Higher Secondary (HSC), Degree, BBA, and MBA programs. He operates an educational YouTube channel democratizing accounting principles and board question breakdowns across Bangladesh.

## Institutional Roles
- **Head of Accounting & Assistant Professor:** Omargani M.E.S. College, Chattogram, Bangladesh.
- **Trustee & Executive Member:** REMA Trust (Charitable health, rural student scholarships, and welfare).
- **Governing Body Member:** Chattogram Laboratory School and College (Academic governance and modernization).
